confidence_flags: Dense plan with several sub-grid beam lines (A', A'', A''' — see grid master). The two front-bay rooms (col1-2 and col2-3, between A and A'') and the B-to-C zone along column 1 are the lowest-confidence parts of this file; several small stub beams ('B1'' near row C/col1 and near row B/col3, both carrying an unexplained '⊠' symbol) could only be positioned approximately.
warnings: '◁1'-style small triangle markers and plain arrows (e.g. '↙+0.50') scattered across the plan are the sheet's own PLANK-laying-direction indicators (per หน้า19's legend '→ แสดงทิศทางการวางพื้นสำเร็จรูป PLANK') paired with that bay's floor level — not beam or slab elements, not recorded as elements[] entries.

The 'S1' bay (diagonal cross-hatch, col1-2, A''-to-B) was initially read as a stairwell VOID by analogy with the identically-drawn 'ช่องบันได' bay on หน้า17 (upper floor). Cross-checked against หน้า22's detail sheet, which shows an 'S1' slab SECTION with real top steel (RB9@0.20) — a real cast-in-place slab, not a void, on this (ground) floor. Recorded as element_type 'slab'. The upper floor's matching bay IS a genuine void (explicitly labelled) — see that file.

Note on this sheet: 'มีคานชานพัก +2.40 (ดูชั้นบน)' ('there is a stair-landing beam at +2.40, see upper floor') with an arrow pointing into the S1 bay near grid 1 — the landing beam itself is not detailed on this sheet (deferred to หน้า17/upper floor per the note) and is not recorded as its own element here to avoid inventing a position; its approximate y-position (2.80m from A) is documented in the grid master's dimension_chains instead.

Two short beams both marked 'B1'' carry an unexplained small '⊠' (cross-in-box) symbol next to them (one near grid ~C1/col1, one near grid ~B3/col3) with no legend entry found for that symbol on this or any other sheet in the set — recorded with approximate grid_ref and low confidence rather than guessing its meaning.

Column 1's run between row B and row D is sparsely marked compared to columns 2/3 — only one 'B1(+0.40)' was legible immediately below row B, and no beam could be confirmed bounding the col1-2 bay between row C and row D (architecturally this is 'รับแขก' living room, so a boundary beam likely exists but its mark was not confidently read). Not inventing one; flagged as a known gap rather than silently completed.

Two 'SO' slab-type circles appear on this sheet at different levels (+0.10 in the canopy, +0.30 in the col1-2 bay between row B and row C) — both are the same mark 'SO' per the drawing; kept as two separate elements (not merged) because they sit at clearly different positions/levels, per the point-element merge exception for genuinely different per-position data (§0.10).
